tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gnam chos las spom ra'i gsol kha ni/1$0000300

gtor ma a kā ro sa byin gyis brlabs la: rang nyid yi dam gang rung bskyed: hūm̐: gter srung rma gnyan spom ra ni: sku mdog dkar po chas dang ldan: g.yas pas mdung dar g.yon bum pa: chibs su rta dkar 'phur shes 'chib: shar phyogs gangs ri rtse rgyal nas: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i mchod gtor bzhes: rigs rgyud btsan dar che ba dang: mnga' thang stobs 'byor dngos grub stsol: yul khams thams cad dbang du sdus: sdang dgra'i dmag tshogs chom la phob: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ āḥbadzra ku li mil man swā hā: i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: sarba pū dza khā hi: oṃ āḥbadzra ku li mil man pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes gnam chos gzhung nas zur du a rā gas bkod pa'o/// / 1$0000250 ༄༅// gnam chos rma chen spom ra'i gsol mchod g.yang skyabs yid bzhin bsam 'phel nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs// 1$0000300gu ru rin po che la 'dud: spom ra nor lha ltar sgrub pa ni: g.yang 'phel zhes bya'i gtor ma zlum po ni: zur brgyad zur la mar gyi skud pa 'then: rtse mor nyi zla nor bus brgyan par bya: mtha' la mar thud pu lus bskor ba bran: rang nyid pad 'byung la sogs yi dam bskyed: mdun du rma gnyan spom ra ni: sku mdog ser po chas dang ldan: g.yas pas sba lcag g.yon ne'u le: chibs su rta ser 'phur shes 'chib: yum dang sras 'khor khrom ltar bskyed: hūm̐: shar phyogs rma g.yang chags pa'i yul: gangs dkar rin chen gzhal yas nas: gter srung spom ra 'khor dang bcas: mchod phyir bsgrub phyir spyan 'dren no: skad cig nyid la 'dir byon nas: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: sngon tshe slob dpon padma yis: bka' bsgos dam tshig dran mdzod la: rnal 'byor bdag gis gang bcol ba'i: las rnams myur mgyogs 'grub par mdzod: badzra sa ma ya dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: tiṣṭha lhan: sa ma ya ho: hūm̐: phyi ltar lha btsan spom ra gnyan:

nang ltar rgyal chen yul 'khor srung: gsang ba khro bo rnam par rgyal: yang gsang bcom ldan rdo rje sems: 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i tshul: gangs can shar phyogs srung ma mdzad: khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: rma rgyal spom ra 'khor bcas la: nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga: bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun: 'bru sman dar zab rin chen tshogs: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul: dpag med mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod: bhrūm̐ las rin chen snod yangs par: khaṃ las gtor ma bdud rtsi'i mtsho: ha ho hrīḥyis byin brlabs pa: zhim mngar ro bcud phun sum tshogs: zag med bde ba bskyed pa 'di: gnyan chen rma gnyan spom ra dang: rma ri rab 'byams drag mo rgyal: rma sras dung mi dkar po dgu: rma rigs sum brgya drug cu dang: sring lcam bzhi bcu rtsa lnga dang: rma gnyan 'bum dang bcas pa la: gsol lo mchod do dgyes par bzhes: oṃ āḥbadzra ku li mil man sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: gsum mam bdun: arghaṃ nas shabda pra tītstsha swā hā: hūm̐: phyi ltar spom ra mgul lha'i gtso: mdo khams sgang drug kun gyi bdag: nang ltar rgyal po yul 'khor srung: dri za bye ba 'bum gyi rje: gsang ba rgyal chen rnam thos sras: sa brgyad sems dpa' nor lha'i mchog: khyod la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: mnga' thang longs spyod 'phel ba dang: khas drags stobs shugs ldan pa yi: khyod la yod pa'i dngos grub de: bdag la da lta nyid du stsol: tshe dpal mnga' thang rlung rta spel: gzhi byes bya ba gang la yang: dus kun kha 'dzin sdongs grogs mdzod: phas rgol g.yul las rgyal ba dang: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces sam: rgyas par spro na: hūm̐: slob dpon padma'i bka' nyan pa: gter srung rma gnyan spom ra ni: 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis: cha lugs gcig tu ma nges kyang: rgyas pa'i phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir:

gser mdog khro 'dzum brjid pa'i zhal: dbu yi dung rmog dkar po la: bya phod ldem dar nyi ltar shar: sku la dar ber sum brtsegs steng: gser khrab stag gi yang sham can: phyag g.yas sba lcag klad la bskor: khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdud: g.yon pas ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin: rin chen nor gyi char pa 'beb: chibs su rta ser 'phur shes la: stag sga gser srab g.yu mthur brgyan: rma sras dung mi dkar po dgu: spu ris ldan pa'i rta dgu 'chib: rma rigs sum brgya drug cu dang: chu drug sgang lnga'i yul lha'i tshogs: kun kyang mi dkar rta dkar la: go cha sra la mtshon cha rno: stag ral g.yas la gzig shub g.yon: ba dan dkar po gnam la g.yug: ki bswo cha sgra di ri ri: rdo rje drag mo rgyal la sogs: 'khor gyi rma gnyan 'bum phrag ni: 'dzum mdzes dar dang rin chen brgyan: glu len bro brdung gar stabs 'khyug: spom ra 'khor dang bcas la bstod: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag dang bsrung byar gyur rnams kyi: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: bkra shis bde legs dngos grub stsol: rigs rgyud btsan dar che ba dang: mi 'phel rta hrag dngos gru stsol: snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dang: 'dod dgu'i dngos grub dbang du sdus: rkang bzhi phyugs dang bang mdzod 'bru: rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub stsol: mi g.yang rta g.yang nor gyi g.yang: rma g.yang nam mkha'i char bzhin phob: oṃ: khu ye khu ye g.yang phob cig: mu ye mu ye g.yang phob cig: ting lam ting lam g.yang phob cig: zu lu zu lu g.yang phob cig: hu ya hu ya g.yang phob cig: rma ye rma ye g.yang phob cig: phywa khug nang du kyi li li: g.yang khug nang du sga ra ra: phywa nyi ma tsam zhig kyi li li: g.yang zla ba tsam zhig sga ra ra: phywa 'di ri la ma bros la: g.yang 'di sgo la ma nyams shig: oṃ āḥbadzra ku li mil man ba su nā nā kha dhe siddhi pha la hūm̐: spom ra'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng:

shaḥyig dkar ser mtha' ma la: sngags de g.yas su 'khor ba las: 'od zer gser mdog phyogs bcur 'phros: rma g.yang dngos grub thams cad dang: rin chen sna tshogs char 'beb bsam: oṃ āḥbadzra ku li mil man ba su nā nā kha dhe siddhi pha la hūm̐: rma rgyal spom ra 'khor bcas kyis: yul khams ma lus dbang bsdus bsam: oṃ āḥbadzra ku li mil man: yul khams thams cad pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de nas 'phyar dar mda' dar sogs: yod na gtso bo de la bstim: 'khor rnams rang gnas gshegs par bsam: sarba bhū ta gatstsha: 'di ni srung mar bsten pa na: sa brgyad sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir: sa lam bar chad sel bar nus: rigs rgyud btsan dar che ba dang: phyug bar dbul gyis mi chod cing: mi 'phel rta hrag 'byung ba dang: sde dpon yin na chus srid rgyas: gzhan gyis mi thub dpung che ba: 'di yi dngos grub yin par bshad: rnal 'byor pa ni yin na yang: gzhi bdag yin phyir rno myur che: gang 'dod bsam pa 'grub pa yin: khyad par 'bri chu phan chad kyi: yul lha'i gtso bo 'di yin zhing: khyad par gling gi mi rigs kyi: pho lha dgra bla 'di yin pas: phyogs de'i mi la thugs brtse'i phyir: 'di nyid bsten na bkra shis dge: de phyir gling gi sa skyong ba: rig 'dzin mgon po lhun grub dang: bla ma bha dra'i mtshan can gyis: nor lha dkor gyi bdag po ru: rgyun du bsten par bya ba'i phyir: sngags 'chang karma a rā gas: gnam chos sgrub thabs kha skong du: ngag nas ji ltar smras pa bzhin: gling gi mi rig dge bshes ni: padmas dad pas yi ger bris: nyes 'gal srung ma nyid la bshags: dge bas 'di nyid sus bton pa: bsod nams mnga' thang 'phel zhing rgyas: 'khor los bsgyur rgyal lta bur shog: maṅga laṃ/// / hrīḥ gangs can shar phyogs rma g.yang gter gyi bdag /rgyal dbang padma'i bka' nyan yul skyong gtso// rma rgyal spom ra bka' 'khor dgyes sde bcas// gsol lo mchod do rma g.yang 'dod dgu stsol//
mi pham pas so// maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
